signal.summary: 这项研究利用仿真或三维场景生成，为具身智能提供训练、测试和安全验证所需的可控环境。

editorial.intro: 这项研究利用仿真或三维场景生成，为具身智能提供训练、测试和安全验证所需的可控环境。
editorial.why_it_matters: 高质量仿真能够降低真实机器人试错成本，但关键在于生成环境是否保留了任务和物理约束。
editorial.watch_next: 继续核对仿真与真实环境之间的差距，以及是否能复现到真实机器人。

evidence.title: Develop Lightweight USD Runtimes Faster with AI Agents
evidence.excerpt: Simulation / Modeling / Design English 中文 Develop Lightweight USD Runtimes Faster with AI Agents Jul 15, 2026 By Dillon Bailey and Pomi Lee Discuss (0) L T F R E AI-Generated Summary The USD Core Specification provides a formal, machine-readable standard that defines how USD data models are composed and resolved across layer stacks. nanousd-labs demonstrates generating a USD runtime directly from that specification using AI agents, producing a lightweight C++ implementation with a stable C ABI. The generated nanousd runtime parses, composes, queries, and writes USD scenes while exposing a fixed C API that allows swapping backends without changing client code. A 10-minute tutorial walks developers through codifying human directions into reusable skills that generate spec-compliant USD parsers. Next Steps Explore the USD Core Spec to understand the formal standard. Experiment with the nanousd-labs project to try agent-generated USD runtimes. Get involved and contribute to the Core Spec Working Group to help shape the standard.
